    - PRICING_MODEL NUMBER(1,0)
    - SETTLEMENT_TYPE_ID NUMBER(4,0)
    - SETTLEMENT_AMOUNT NUMBER(24,6)
    - CONTRACT_ID VARCHAR2(25)
    - INITIAL_DATE DATE
    - TERMINATION_DATE DATE
    - LEG NUMBER(1,0)
    - REPURCHASE_PRICE NUMBER(16,4)
    - DIRTY_PRICE NUMBER(16,4)
    - BUYER_TRADER_ID NUMBER(30,0)
    - SELLER_TRADER_ID NUMBER(30,0)
  Date key: ENTRY_DATETIME
  Dimensions:
  - SYMBOL_ID
  - EXCHANGE_ID
  - MARKET_ID
  - BUYER_CLIENT_ID
  - SELLER_CLIENT_ID
  - BUYER_BROKER_ID
  - SELLER_BROKER_ID
  - BUYER_USER_ID
  - SELLER_USER_ID
  - BUYER_TRADER_ID
  - SELLER_TRADER_ID
  - STATE_ID
  - SETTLEMENT_TYPE_ID
  - TRADE_TYPE
  - IS_SHORT (It is either 1 or O)
  Measures:
  - trades: COUNT(*)
  - volume: SUM(VOLUME)
  - notional_computed: SUM(PRICE * VOLUME)
  - settlement_amount: SUM(SETTLEMENT_AMOUNT)
  - avg_price: AVG(PRICE)
  - avg_dirty_price: AVG(DIRTY_PRICE)
  - avg_yield: AVG(YIELD)
  - **accrued_profit: SUM(ACCRUED_PROFIT)**
  - avg_repurchase_price: AVG(REPURCHASE_PRICE)

    • TRADES has buyer_* and seller_* party columns; no explicit SIDE.• DIRTY_PRICE is clean+accrued (primarily bonds).SETTLEMENT_AMOUNT is the cash consideration.• Remaining volumes may be non-zero due to partial fills (do not assume zero).• Use (SYMBOL_ID, MARKET_ID, EXCHANGE_ID) to join venue info via SYMBOL_MARKETS when needed.- When asked about the Profit for the broker client or anything, Dont go towards summing the Value/Notional , Since its wrong.Always go towards the Sum of Accrued profit.## ATS.CANCELLED_TRADES  (grain: cancel_event)
